description: This file defines the PointerTracker class used for handling touch input events on a custom keyboard view in an Android application. It manages key press states, multi-tap, gesture typing, and visual feedback for key presses.

classes.name: PointerTracker
classes.description: Handles touch input events for a specific pointer, managing key states, gesture detection, multi-tap, and visual feedback.

classes.name: SharedPointerTrackersData
classes.description: Holds shared data for multiple PointerTracker instances, such as last sent key index and timeouts for key repeat and multi-tap.

classes.name: UIProxy
classes.description: Interface for UI operations like invalidating keys and showing/hiding key previews.

classes.name: KeyState
classes.description: Tracks the current key index and position for a pointer, handling movement and state updates.

methods.name: PointerTracker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PointerTracker with necessary handlers, detectors, and shared data.

methods.name: setOnKeyboardActionListener
methods.description: Sets the listener for keyboard actions.

methods.name: setKeyboard
methods.description: Assigns the current keyboard keys to the tracker.

methods.name: isValidKeyIndex
methods.description: Checks if a key index is within valid bounds.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves a key object at a given index.

methods.name: isModifier
methods.description: Checks if the current key is a modifier key.

methods.name: isOnModifierKey
methods.description: Checks if a given coordinate is on a modifier key.

methods.name: onDownEvent
methods.description: Handles touch down events at given coordinates.

methods.name: onMoveEvent
methods.description: Handles move events during touch input.

methods.name: onUpEvent
methods.description: Handles touch up events.

methods.name: onCancelEvent
methods.description: Handles touch cancel events.

methods.name: repeatKey
methods.description: Repeats a key press programmatically.

methods.name: getLastX
methods.description: Returns the last X coordinate of the pointer.

methods.name: getLastY
methods.description: Returns the last Y coordinate of the pointer.

methods.name: isMinorMoveBounce
methods.description: Determines if a move is a minor bounce within hysteresis distance.

methods.name: getSquareDistanceToKeyEdge
methods.description: Calculates squared distance from a point to the edge of a key.

methods.name: showKeyPreviewAndUpdateKey
methods.description: Updates key state and shows key preview.

methods.name: startLongPressTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer for long-press detection.

methods.name: shouldLongPressQuickly
methods.description: Determines if a key should trigger a quick long-press.

methods.name: detectAndSendKey
methods.description: Detects the pressed key and sends corresponding actions.

methods.name: getPreviewText
methods.description: Returns the text to display in the key preview based on multi-tap and shift state.

methods.name: resetMultiTap
methods.description: Resets multi-tap state.

methods.name: checkMultiTap
methods.description: Checks and updates multi-tap state based on timing and key index.

methods.name: isInGestureTyping
methods.description: Returns whether gesture typing is active.

methods.name: canDoGestureTyping
methods.description: Returns whether gesture typing can be performed.
